Case No.: LM-2018-01, MV-2018-03 (Parking Spaces) Location: 232-234 N. Azusa Avenue, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8611-026-016 & 8611-026-017
Applicant: Brianne Luu
The proposed project will consolidate two (2) existing nonconforming lots into one (1) lot located in the CAZ (Azusa Avenue Corridor) zone. The lot merger is being proposed to bring the proposed lots into closer conformance of the Azusa Development Code. Minor Variance is for a ten (10) percent reduction of required parking spaces from nine (9) spaces to eight (8) spaces.
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 1 and Class 5 Categorical Exemptions (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15301 and 15305), (California Environmental Quality Act).
